headline: Argentina aims to fast-track US trade agreement before year-end
summary: President Javier Milei's administration seeks to submit a trade agreement with the US to Congress before year-end, while Washington reviews supply chain product traceability and steel tariff concerns.
why: Argentina is seeking expanded market access for industrial and agricultural exports under the Milei administration's free-market agenda.

impacts.name: Argentina
impacts.why: Fast-tracking trade negotiations aims to streamline market access and bilateral investment.
